source_name: CFO Forum Slovensko (Bratislava) - corporate-finance/treasury event
why_relevant: CFO-level Slovak event where corporate treasury and payment-service buying decisions are discussed; a demand-side counterpart to bank-side conferences. Listing found on a third-party exhibition aggregator, so the canonical organiser page still needs to be identified.

source_name: RÚZ Open API (v2.5) — machine-readable filings feed
why_relevant: Documented JSON REST API over the whole register: /api/uctovne-jednotky, /api/uctovne-zavierky, /api/uctovne-vykazy, /api/vyrocne-spravy plus detail and codebook endpoints (pravne-formy, sk-nace). Supports incremental pulls via zmenene-od, so a scheduled collector can detect new bank/PSP filings the day they land. Documentation states CC0 licensing.

source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) — company search
why_relevant: Authoritative company register (Ministry of Justice / registry courts): legal form, registered capital, statutory bodies, shareholders, branches of foreign banks, historical changes. Baseline identity resolution (IČO, spisová značka) for every bank, PSP and fintech in scope; also the entry to the Zbierka listín.

source_name: Zbierka listín Obchodného registra (ORSR document collection)
why_relevant: Statutory document collection: founding deeds, articles of association and their amendments, minutes on capital increases, mergers/cross-border mergers, auditor appointments, and historically financial statements. For non-listed banks, PSPs and fintechs this is often the only place where ownership restructurings and capital injections are documented.

source_name: Elektronické služby Obchodného registra (sluzby.orsr.sk)
why_relevant: New MS SR portal for e-services of the commercial register: request a document from the zbierka listín, file registrations/changes. Practical retrieval channel for the documents indexed on orsr.sk, and a signal source for pending corporate changes.

source_name: Obchodný vestník (Commercial Bulletin, MS SR)
why_relevant: Official electronic gazette. Audited entities publish balance-sheet and P&L data here; it also carries mergers, liquidations, insolvency/restructuring notices, general-meeting convocations and mandatory contract publications. High-frequency event feed complementing the annual RÚZ cadence.

source_name: Register partnerov verejného sektora (RPVS) — rpvs.gov.sk
why_relevant: Any bank, PSP or IT/payments vendor receiving public money above thresholds must be registered with verified beneficial owners (konečný užívateľ výhod) and a verification document (verifikačný dokument) drafted by an oprávnená osoba. Reveals ownership chains and public-sector exposure that no annual report discloses.

source_name: RPVS Open Data / REST API (Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR)
why_relevant: Automated REST access to RPVS records — partners, beneficial owners, authorised persons — enabling systematic ownership-graph building across Slovak payments actors instead of one-off lookups.

source_name: Ministerstvo spravodlivosti SR — registre / otvorené dáta hub
why_relevant: Central pointer to MS SR register APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger UI at obcan.justice.sk) and to a contact channel (servicedesk.mssr@justice.sk) for extended datasets or bulk integration — the route to negotiated access if public endpoints are insufficient.

source_name: Register právnických osôb, podnikateľov a orgánov verejnej moci (RPO) — REST API
why_relevant: Consolidated identity register (Štatistický úrad SR / MV SR) merging commercial register, trade register and other source registers. Best authoritative key for IČO↔name↔legal form↔SK NACE resolution, which every downstream filing collector depends on. Licensed CC-BY 4.0.

source_name: Index Podnikateľa (indexpodnikatela.sk)
why_relevant: Scoring/aggregation of company financial and compliance data (registers of debtors in social/health insurance and tax). Cheap early-warning signal on distress among smaller SK fintechs and payment intermediaries that file minimal statements.

source_name: Registre NBS / registre.nbs.sk — supervised entity lists incl. PSD2 register
why_relevant: Not a filing channel itself, but the authoritative pointer that defines WHICH legal entities are banks, branches of foreign banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, agents and consumer-credit providers. Converting these lists into an IČO watchlist is the prerequisite for targeting the registry channel at the right actors.

source_name: Slovensko.sk — 'Zverejňovanie finančných výsledkov firiem' life-situation guide
why_relevant: Official state explanation of who must file what, where and by when (RÚZ vs Obchodný vestník vs zbierka listín), including audit thresholds. Sets the expected filing calendar and completeness baseline for the collector.

source_name: Finančná správa SR — filing of accounting documents into RÚZ (methodology + eKAP)
why_relevant: Financial Administration is the intake channel: statements are submitted electronically to FS SR and forwarded into the RÚZ. Its methodological guidance explains form structures, XML templates and deadlines that determine how machine-readable a given filing will be.

source_name: BRIS / e-Justice Business Registers Interconnection — Slovak node
why_relevant: EU-level interconnection giving standardised, English-language core company data for Slovak entities and cross-border filing notifications (mergers, branches). Practical English entry point when orsr.sk offers no English UI, and useful for tracking foreign banks' SK branches.

source_name: Schmidt & Schmidt — Slovak financial statements retrieval & translation
why_relevant: Commercial intermediary supplying certified Slovak financial statements and register extracts with English translation. Fallback when a target's filing is only in Slovak PDF/scanned form or when a certified copy is needed for a client deliverable.

source_name: RÚZ public-part user manual (Príručka používateľa, PDF)
why_relevant: Documents the search semantics, document types and attachment structure of the public RÚZ, including how consolidated vs individual statements and annual reports are stored — needed to build a correct crawler and to interpret missing filings.

source_name: registeructovnychzavierok.sk — explainer on Zbierka listín OR and Obchodný vestník
why_relevant: Private explainer site clarifying the division of labour between RÚZ, zbierka listín and Obchodný vestník after the 2014 reform. Useful glossary/context source; note it is NOT the official register despite the domain name — a naming trap to record.

source_name: Podnikajte.sk / Podnikam.sk — filing-obligation reporting on RÚZ
why_relevant: Practitioner media that tracks changes to filing rules (e.g. the June 2025 transparency-report duty for non-profit legal entities, document-type changes). Early warning that the statutory channel's schema or scope is about to change.

source_name: CERI – Centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií (NBS Officially Appointed Mechanism)
why_relevant: Slovakia's statutory central storage mechanism for regulated information under the Transparency Directive (2004/109/EC), operated by Národná banka Slovenska. Every bank with securities admitted to the BCPB regulated market must file annual and half-yearly financial reports, inside information, voting-rights notifications, managers' transactions and debt-security holder information here. Historical archive back to June 2007. This is the legally mandated, complete feed for SK bank issuer disclosure — richer and more reliable than voluntary IR pages.

source_name: NBS – Emitenti cenných papierov (issuer obligations & downloadable filing forms)
why_relevant: Authoritative page defining WHAT issuers must file and in which template — 'Ročná správa', 'Polročná správa', 'Formulár zverejňovania informácií emitentmi dlhových cenných papierov' (XLS), voting-rights and home-Member-State notification forms. Gives the schema/vocabulary needed to parse CERI filings, and identifies the debt-securities-specific disclosure stream that covers bank bond issuers.

source_name: NBS – ESEF guidance for Slovak issuers (deferral, XHTML/iXBRL obligation)
why_relevant: Defines the machine-readability boundary for the SK cell: Slovakia used the one-year ESEF deferral, so mandatory XHTML (and iXBRL tagging of IFRS consolidated statements) applies from FY2021 reports filed in 2022 onward; PDF-only annual financial reports are explicitly treated as non-compliance with §34 Securities Act. This tells the collector that SK bank annual financial reports from 2022 onwards should be structured-parseable, while earlier years are PDF.

source_name: Burza cenných papierov v Bratislave (BCPB / BSSE) – exchange website
why_relevant: Sole regulated-market operator in Slovakia and the venue where bank bonds, covered bonds (hypotekárne záložné listy / kryté dlhopisy) and MREL instruments are admitted. Publishes issuer lists, listed-security detail pages, price lists (kurzový lístok), SAX index, exchange rules and issuer announcements. It is the counterpart feed to CERI: admission/delisting events and issuer notices routed via BISE.

source_name: BCPB – Informačné povinnosti emitenta (issuer information duties)
why_relevant: Specifies what each issuer must disclose depending on the market tier of admission (kótovaný hlavný trh vs regulovaný voľný trh) and the accepted submission channels (BISE, e-mail ok@bsse.sk, post). Needed to know which bank issuers have which disclosure obligations and therefore what the collector should expect to exist.

source_name: BISE – Burzový informačný systém emitentov (BSSE issuer information system)
why_relevant: The electronic channel through which BCPB-listed issuers (including banks) transmit disclosures; BSSE then redistributes them to domestic and international press agencies and the public. Identifying BISE matters because it explains the propagation path of a Slovak bank announcement (issuer → BISE → agencies/media), i.e. where the same item can be picked up downstream if the primary page is blocked.

source_name: BCPB – Jednotný elektronický formát vykazovania (ESEF) page
why_relevant: Exchange-side ESEF instructions for listed issuers; complements the NBS ESEF notice and helps confirm which SK issuers file iXBRL-tagged annual financial reports vs plain XHTML (tagging is only mandatory for IFRS consolidated statements, which is decisive for bank groups).

source_name: Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR, a.s. (CDCP SR) – national numbering agency & issue register
why_relevant: Sole Slovak CSD and the national numbering agency assigning ISIN/CFI/FISN under ISO 6166. Every dematerialised bank bond or covered-bond issue must have an ISIN assigned and be registered with CDCP before admission. CDCP is therefore the earliest-visible signal of a new bank funding instrument — often before the prospectus surfaces on CERI — and the authoritative issuer↔ISIN mapping key that links CERI filings, BCPB listings and ECB/market data.

source_name: NBS – Zoznam bánk emitujúcich kryté dlhopisy a správcov programu krytých dlhopisov
why_relevant: Definitive, regulator-maintained roster of exactly which Slovak banks run a covered-bond programme, plus the cover-pool administrator (správca programu krytých dlhopisov) and deputy. This is the cleanest way to scope the universe of SK bank regulated issuers in this cell — it converts 'which banks disclose under this channel' from guesswork into an authoritative list.
